title: Accept M8 Release and upgrade?
body: No question this time: the milestone table and the accepted documents settle M8. Accepting applies any annotations you make. I then commit it, and the final board asks you to confirm the whole specification. If you would rather see changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
